entries.name: Apereo CAS
entries.use_for: Self-host enterprise single sign-on (CAS, SAML, OIDC, OAuth2)
entries.why: Long-standing SSO server used across universities and enterprises, supporting CAS, SAML2, OIDC, MFA and delegated auth.

entries.name: Auth.js (NextAuth)
entries.use_for: Add OAuth, email and credentials sign-in to Next.js and other JS frameworks.
entries.why: Long-standing default for Next.js auth with many built-in providers and database adapters.

entries.name: Authelia
entries.use_for: SSO and multi-factor portal that protects apps behind a reverse proxy.
entries.why: OpenID Certified, lightweight and popular for self-hosted setups.

entries.name: authentik
entries.use_for: Self-hosted identity provider with SSO, OIDC, SAML, LDAP and proxy auth
entries.why: Popular self-hosted IdP alternative to Okta/Keycloak

license_verified.note: MIT core; authentik/enterprise/ under its own enterprise license, website/ CC BY-SA 4.0

entries.name: Authlib
entries.use_for: Build OAuth 2.0 and OpenID Connect clients and servers in Python.
entries.why: Spec-complete library with integrations for Flask, Django, FastAPI and httpx.

entries.name: Better Auth
entries.use_for: Framework-agnostic TypeScript auth with email/password, OAuth, 2FA, orgs and plugins.
entries.why: Fast-growing, comprehensive self-hosted auth for TS apps; user data stays in your own database.

entries.name: Casbin
entries.use_for: Authorization library supporting ACL, RBAC and ABAC models.
entries.why: Language-portable policy engine with ports for Node, Python, Java and more.

entries.name: Casdoor
entries.use_for: UI-first IAM / SSO platform with OAuth, OIDC, SAML and LDAP
entries.why: Popular open-source IAM from the Casbin org

entries.name: Clerk JavaScript SDKs
entries.use_for: Official SDKs for Clerk hosted auth: drop-in sign-in, user and organization components.
entries.why: Fastest path to polished auth UI if a hosted service is acceptable; official vendor repo.

entries.name: Devise
entries.use_for: Flexible authentication for Rails apps.
entries.why: The standard Rails authentication gem with a large extension ecosystem.

entries.name: django-allauth
entries.use_for: Authentication, registration, social login and MFA for Django.
entries.why: The go-to Django auth package with many social providers.

entries.name: jose
entries.use_for: JWT, JWS, JWE and JWK for every JS runtime
entries.why: Most used universal JWT library; used by Auth.js and others

entries.name: Keycloak
entries.use_for: Self-hosted identity and access management with SSO, OIDC, SAML and user federation.
entries.why: CNCF project and the most widely deployed open-source IAM server.

entries.name: Logto
entries.use_for: Auth and authorization infrastructure for SaaS and AI apps, built on OIDC.
entries.why: Developer-friendly Auth0 alternative with organizations, RBAC and many SDKs.

entries.name: node-oidc-provider
entries.use_for: Build an OpenID-certified OAuth 2.0 / OIDC provider in Node
entries.why: Certified OIDC provider library used by many IdPs

entries.name: OAuth2 Proxy
entries.use_for: Put OAuth2/OIDC login in front of any web app
entries.why: Standard way to protect internal apps behind SSO

entries.name: Ory Hydra
entries.use_for: Certified OAuth 2.0 and OpenID Connect server
entries.why: OpenID-certified OAuth2 provider; complements Ory Kratos

entries.name: Ory Kratos
entries.use_for: Headless, API-first identity and user management server (login, registration, MFA, recovery).
entries.why: Cloud-native, bring-your-own-UI identity server; part of the Ory stack with Hydra for OAuth2.

entries.name: SimpleWebAuthn
entries.use_for: Add passkeys/WebAuthn to TS apps with server and browser helpers
entries.why: Most used WebAuthn library for JS

entries.name: SuperTokens
entries.use_for: Self-hostable auth with sessions, passwordless and social login
entries.why: Open-source alternative to Auth0/Firebase Auth with SDKs

license_verified.note: Apache-2.0 outside ee/; ee/ under its own enterprise license

entries.name: ZITADEL
entries.use_for: Identity infrastructure with multi-tenancy, OIDC/SAML, passkeys and audit trail.
entries.why: Strong multi-tenant B2B support; self-host or use the cloud. AGPL-3.0.
